mapper.select: SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm, A.GROUP_ID AS groupId, A.GROUP_NM AS groupNm, A.GROUP_ENG_NM AS groupEngNm, A.GROUP_CN AS groupCn, A.USE_FL AS useFl, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creationDt FROM CM_GROUP A INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , B.USER_ID AS userId , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN C.USER_ENG_NM ELSE C.USER_NM END AS userNm , DL.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_GROUP_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND B.MBRSH_SQ = A.MBRSH_SQ AND B.USE_FL = 'Y' INNER JOIN CM_USER C ON C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN CM_DEPT D ON D.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND D.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = D.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY B.USER_ID

SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , A.USER_ID AS userId , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN B.USER_ENG_NM ELSE B.USER_NM END AS userNm , DL.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID INNER JOIN CM_DEPT C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = C.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y'
AND (A.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.USER_ENG_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY A.USER_ID

WITH RECURSIVE CODE_HIERARCHY AS ( SELECT C.DEPT_CD, C.DEPT_NM_KEY, C.UPPER_DEPT_CD, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(C.DEPT_CD AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_DEPT C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.UPPER_DEPT_CD = '#' AND C.EXPRTN_YMD > DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') UNION ALL SELECT C.DEPT_CD, C.DEPT_NM_KEY, C.UPPER_DEPT_CD, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(CONCAT(CH.PATH, '>', C.DEPT_CD) AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, CH.TREE_LEVEL + 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_DEPT C INNER JOIN CODE_HIERARCHY CH ON C.UPPER_DEPT_CD = CH.DEPT_CD WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' ) SELECT CH.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , DL.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm , CH.UPPER_DEPT_CD AS upperDeptCd , CH.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd , CH.USE_FL AS useFl , CH.PATH AS path , CH.TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel FROM CODE_HIERARCHY CH LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = CH.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} ORDER BY CH.PATH

SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , A.USER_ID AS userId , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN B.USER_ENG_NM ELSE B.USER_NM END AS userNm , DL.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID INNER JOIN CM_DEPT C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = C.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_GROUP ( CMPNY_CD, GROUP_ID, GROUP_NM, GROUP_ENG_NM, GROUP_CN, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{groupId}, #{groupNm}, #{groupEngNm}, #{groupCn}, #{useFl}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CM_GROUP_USER (CMPNY_CD, GROUP_ID, MBRSH_SQ, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT) VALUES (#{cmpnyCd}, #{groupId}, #{mbrshSq}, 'Y', #{creationId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_GROUP SET GROUP_NM = #{groupNm}, GROUP_ENG_NM = #{groupEngNm}, GROUP_CN = #{groupCn}, USE_FL = #{useFl}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CM_GROUP WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
DELETE FROM CM_GROUP_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
